messages:
sneh: Heads up — updating the Private telemetry opt-in policy for air-gapped/on-prem installs. This affects customers that previously relied on 'implicit' telemetry for health and usage. Posting the new internal summary and the customer-facing FAQ here.

jon: TL;DR: for air-gapped customers we now default telemetry to OFF and provide an explicit enable flow that requires local consent + signed attestation. No automatic pings.

security: Important: the attestation flow must not include any PII and needs to use the HSM-backed signing key. I've added requirements to the compliance appendix.

product-bot: Docs draft published: docs/private/telemetry-optin-policy-v2.md (author: sneh)

jon: Sample config we plan to ship for on-prem customers (in docs):

```yaml
telemetry:
  enabled: false  # default for air-gapped / private installs
  mode: "minimal"  # options: minimal, full (full only with consent)
  attestation:
    required: true
    signer: "customer-hsm"
```

sneh: Customer impact notes: 1) No change to Hosted or Dedicated out-of-the-box. 2) Private installs will need an explicit opt-in to get cost telemetry for billing reconciliation. 3) Support artifacts include how to generate the attestation token.

security: Add-on: when customers enable telemetry we will expose a signed timestamped manifest of what fields are sent. That manifest must be stored by the customer for audit evidence.

jon: Ops note: we will include a CLI helper to produce the attestation and to run a preflight check that simulates minimal telemetry without sending data.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy started: docs/private/telemetry-optin-policy-v2 -> staging (build 20260330.8)

sneh: Action items: @security finalize manifest schema, @jon add CLI helper and preflight, support to update KB with attestation examples. Target internal notif Mon, customer comms Wed.

security: Will post manifest schema to the doc by EOD. Keeping fields minimal.

jon: I'll add the preflight and attach sample attestation output to the KB.

sneh: Thanks — trying to reduce surprise for customers during audits. If anyone sees regulatory blockers ping me directly.
